data.narrative:
Genesis AI is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $105M to date. The target operates within a sector comprising nine peer companies—one public (277810.KQ) and eight private entities including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI—though a sufficiently narrow peer cohort for direct median comparison is unavailable.

The stage-progression method is the primary applicable triangulation approach, using the $105M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement. This produces an implied valuation of $262M. No peer-median methodology can be reliably applied; while ten same-sector peers exist, insufficient datapoints meeting same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters preclude robust multi-method triangulation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $223M (low) to $302M (high), with a median point of $262M. This range is driven entirely by stage-progression dynamics and carries material uncertainty due to reliance on a single method. Key unknowns include Genesis AI's unit economics relative to the broader robotics peer set, revenue traction, and path to Series A—factors that would typically calibrate the step-up multiplier but are not quantified in available data. A fuller valuation would benefit from comparable transaction multiples or revenue-based benchmarking once additional peer metrics become available.
